entities.summary: Dmitry Borisovich Vybornov is a retired male boxer from Russia. He represented his native country at the 1996 Summer Olympics in Atlanta, Georgia, where he was stopped in the first round of the men's light-heavyweight division by USA's eventual bronze medalist Antonio Tarver. Dmitry Vybornov was a athletes & competitors from Samara (b. 1970-02-23, Samara). Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
